title: Viññāṇasuttaṃ
text: 314 . Sāvatthinidānaṃ . ‘‘Yo kho, bhikkhave, cakkhuviññāṇassa uppādo ṭhiti…pe… jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo…pe… yo manoviññāṇassa uppādo ṭhiti…pe… jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo. Yo ca kho, bhikkhave, cakkhuviññāṇassa nirodho…pe… jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo…pe… yo manoviññāṇassa nirodho…pe… jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo’’ti. Tatiyaṃ.
